name: Pension Linda
beschreibung:
Overview

Pension Linda is located at Brennerfeld 2, 6370 Kitzbühel, on the outskirts of the town and about 200 metres from the centre. The accommodation comprises twelve rooms that are practically furnished and each has its own bathroom with shower; some units also have a balcony. A breakfast buffet is served every morning. Free Wi-Fi is available in the public areas. The house also includes a shared lounge with a television, a small in-house bar and a garden where guests can relax. The Hahnenkamm ski area is about 600 metres away, and the nearest ski storage room is available free of charge.

History/Background

There is no reliable information about the origins of the house. What can be verified is the location at Brennerfeld 2 on the edge of Kitzbühel's town centre and the small size of the accommodation with twelve rooms. Kitzbühel is a well-known Tyrolean municipality at the foot of the Hahnenkamm massif; according to the information available, the Hahnenkamm ski area is about 600 metres from the guesthouse. Further historical details cannot be substantiated from the available sources and are therefore not listed here.

Getting there

The guesthouse is located on the outskirts of Kitzbühel, only about 200 metres from the centre. Private parking is available for guests at the property. A bus stop is about 100 metres from the house. The Hahnenkamm ski area can be reached in about 600 metres. The nearest airport, W. A. Mozart Airport near Salzburg, is about 60 kilometres away according to the sources. The Casino Kitzbühel is given as approximately 0.54 kilometres away.

Tips

The morning breakfast buffet is usually included in the stay. A free ski storage room and private parking make the stay easier for winter sports guests. The garden and the shared lounge with a television invite you to linger, and a small bar is available in the house. The nearest restaurant is about 200 metres away, so dinner can also be arranged on foot. The accommodation is run as a non-smoking establishment, and pets are allowed.

Best time to travel

Kitzbühel is suitable for stays in both winter and summer. In the winter months, skiing and the nearby Hahnenkamm ski area are the main focus, while in the warmer season hiking and cycling are among the activities mentioned. No general recommendation can be derived from the available sources; the choice of travel time therefore depends on personal interest in winter or summer activities.
